tasks.title: Conversation #14
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Thanks for your help. The deadline to apply for the marketing position is Friday, so I need to finish updating my resume. I'm cutting it close.
Man: Tell me about it. I applied for a job last month, and I didn't submit the materials until the last minute.
Woman: Good to know. So I think these sections are fine. Education references. But I'm not sure I've accurately captured my work history.
Man: And tip, don't ramble on about your previous jobs. You want to keep things brief since the people in charge of hiring probably won't spend much time reviewing your resume.

questions.stem: What does the man mean when he says, "Tell me about it"?

options.A: He is familiar with the situation the woman describes.
options.B: He is interested in finding a new job.
options.C: He wants to know more about the marketing position.
options.D: He wants help writing his resume.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士说“Tell me about it”时的含义，属于语义理解题，需结合上下文理解这一习语的实际意思。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 “Tell me about it”在此处是口语习语，表示“我深有同感”或“我完全了解”。男士接着说他自己上个月申请工作时也是最后一刻才提交材料，说明他对女士描述的时间紧迫的情况非常熟悉。 选项B：错误。 男士并未表示对找新工作感兴趣，只是在分享自己的经历，属于偏离核心语义。 选项C：错误。 男士没有询问营销职位的更多信息，而是在回应女士关于时间紧迫的感慨。 选项D：错误。 对话中没有提到男士需要帮助写简历，是女士在更新自己的简历。

questions.stem: What advice does the man give the woman?

options.A: She should reconsider applying for a marketing position.
options.B: She should make her writing concise.
options.C: She should ask for a deadline extension.
options.D: She should quit her current job.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士给了女士什么建议，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士在对话末尾提出的具体建议。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 男士没有建议她重新考虑申请营销职位，而是帮助她修改简历内容。 选项B：正确。 男士明确说“don't ramble on about your previous jobs. You want to keep things brief”，意思是不要啰嗦，要简洁明了，即建议她写得简明扼要。 选项C：错误。 对话中提到截止日期是周五，但男士并未建议她申请延期。 选项D：错误。 对话中完全没有提到辞职，属于与原文无关的干扰项。
